title: Hierarchical Alignment: Block-Level LoRA-DPO for Preference Tuning in Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2510.12044v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Preference tuning typically distributes adapter updates across every Transformer layer. We study how the placement of a fixed LoRA budget affects Direct Preference Optimization (DPO). Hierarchical Alignment partitions decoder depth into Local, Intermediate, and Global regions and restricts LoRA updates to a chosen contiguous block. Across Qwen and Llama models, three-seed sliding-window sweeps reveal broad low-loss basins around intermediate depth. Under exact trainableparameter matching, Middle achieves lower held-out DPO loss than an all-depth allocation on Qwen2.5-7B and Llama-3.1-8B. Generationlevel evidence is more variable. LLM judges and a blinded human study leave Selected versus All unresolved on Qwen; on Llama, two pairwise judges favor All while the human interval includes zero. Trained-adapter interventions show that learned depth components affect the optimization objective; removing the Llama Selected window also

translated_title: 分层对齐：面向大语言模型偏好调优的块级LoRA-DPO方法
translated_abstract: 偏好调优通常将适配器更新分布在每一个Transformer层上。我们研究了固定LoRA预算的放置位置如何影响直接偏好优化（DPO）。分层对齐方法将解码器深度划分为局部、中间和全局三个区域，并将LoRA更新限制在选定的连续块内。在Qwen和Llama模型上的三种子滑动窗口扫描实验显示，中间深度附近存在广泛的低损失盆地。在可训练参数精确匹配的条件下，在Qwen2.5-7B和Llama-3.1-8B上，中间深度配置比全深度分配取得了更低的留出集DPO损失。生成层面的证据则更具变异性：LLM评判和盲测人类研究在Qwen上无法在Selected与All之间得出定论；在Llama上，两个成对评判者偏好All，而人类评估的置信区间包含零。对训练后适配器的干预实验表明，学习到的深度组件会影响优化目标；移除Llama的Selected窗口也会……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出分层对齐方法，将LoRA-DPO的更新限制在解码器中间深度的连续块内而非所有层，在可训练参数量完全相同的情况下取得了更低的偏好优化损失，证明了适配器放置位置对大语言模型偏好调优效果的关键影响。
en_tdlr: Hierarchical Alignment restricts LoRA-DPO updates to a contiguous block at intermediate decoder depth instead of all layers, achieving lower held-out preference optimization loss than all-depth allocation under exactly matched trainable parameter budgets, revealing that adapter placement critically affects preference tuning in large language models.
